files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Umiri Yahata shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

Our first impression was that Ave Mujica was merely a student band that had stumbled upon Rhodes Island. Our thinking changed, however, as they blended into Rhodes, and began to ask how they could help.
We were surprised at how quickly Umiri Yahata absorbed new knowledge and put it into practice, and how she took the initiative in communication and working with others, supporting her team in the same way that the bass supports the rest of the band.
She is always calm, never flustered regardless of the situation—at least, so we thought.

'Umiri helps out our planning work here at Rhodes. She'll draft us a whole array of plans, all of them easy to understand and execute on. She's highly reliable, and we owe more than our fair share to her.'
A very fast learner, Umiri quickly earned the trust of many teams with her thorough planning and schedule management.
She is quick to grasp the mission objective and see it through without a hitch, making her the ideal partner.
'She's a serious and brisk worker, but there's always this distance between her and us...' So operators who work with her may feel on occasion, but quickly dismiss it, assuming they're just overthinking it.

It is true that Umiri has kept her distance from those around her, but it is not because she is wary of others.
She was overly eager in her first band, frequently giving instructions that she believed would help the band succeed, but ended up drawing the ire of the other band members, causing the band to fall apart.

It is easy to forget that Umiri is still a young student facing challenges appropriate to her age, so outstanding are her bass skills and management ability.
She pushes herself hard with a schedule that is packed to the brim between work and practice, as well as a rigorous training regimen.
Despite her image of perfection, Umiri can find it stressful when things do not go according to plan. Binge shopping at the Rhodes Island shop is her way of blowing off steam. While the operators there are overjoyed to see her, and take photos of her with both hands full of shopping bags as commemoration, they also remind her not to go overboard with her purchases.

[Iris's Notes]
On a subconscious level, Umiri is aware that the reason she cannot establish relations of trust with others is because she cannot bare her true heart to them.
She must overcome her past trauma and step out of her comfort zone, and once again reveal her heart to her friends.
When the day should come that Umiri wakes from the dream and forgets all that transpired within, may a part of what she experienced here remain with her and give her courage—
The courage to face others with her true heart.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: You can leave that paperwork, I handled it already. Any issues, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I've noticed Rhodes Island's ops don't tend to hold back on strength or personality. But nobody clashes with anyone. They're all able to treat each other with respect. I don't know what to make of it, honestly.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Vigna invited me to see her perform live. She's got impressive guitar skills. I'm really looking forward to it.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: No need for concern. Practice time and rest time are both fully blocked out on my schedule, and I've given myself plenty of leeway in my work hours. I'm never going to collapse.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: As long as Rhodes Island is going to look after me, I owe it to your people to help you out.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: The relationship between you and Amiya-san is a good influence on everyone else. Just one of those Rhodes things. The people here all think of each other as family. I'm just as honored to be able to contribute.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: These honey biscuits Ceobe-san likes are good. It's hard to stop eating them.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I know everyone at Rhodes Island has their own troubles, but they all prop each other up through whatever they're going through. I really owe a lot to them, especially you, Doctor. I'm very thankful.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: A boatloads of squads requested for me to help them out with things again. I'll work through each task one by one for everyone at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Hmm... Doctor, I see you're still working at it. Here, a chocolate panna cotta to keep you going.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Umiri Yahata. If you need anything, just ask.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I like the efficiency. I'm taking notes.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm just doing what I'm supposed to.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I'm happy that everyone at Rhodes Island has accepted me. Perhaps they might even be able to fulfill my wishes too, don't you think?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: You want me to lead? Understood.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let's get going.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I expected this. Let's go.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm? Need me?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: In position.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Right on target.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Leave it to me.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This is easy.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Hrnph!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mission complete. Couldn't have done it without you all.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: That was some nice leadership, Doctor.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That was a close call. We need more practice under our belt.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let's hustle. We're not going to leave anyone behind.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: So this is the area I can freely utilize? Where's the training room then?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Eh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Yes. I'm here.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor. Happy New Year. I'm looking forward to our new journey ahead.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor. Want to head to training?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: There you are. Doctor, happy birthday. Here's your cake and your present. I guarantee it'll be good. I've had that store's cake before.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: You know. Little by little I've opened up, here at Rhodes Island. Now I can put my own thoughts out there without worrying what others think of me. I have the people of Rhodes Island to thank for that, as well as you. So thank you, Doctor.
